name: dossier-pdf
description: Builds research dossiers and briefing documents as designed PDFs. A dark cover whose palette and geometric motif are derived from the subject, then dense editorial body pages with themed tables, callout boxes and running header/footer furniture. Ships a ReportLab builder library, 21 cover motifs, seven subject palettes, a cover preview and motif contact sheet, a build scaffold, and a pre-ship verifier that catches margin overhang, undrawable glyphs, blank pages and missing content. Use when turning research or collected notes into a polished PDF, or when a PDF needs a themed cover instead of a default one.
